scope.restart_behavior: tasks and replay buffers disappear; old task URLs return the unified 404
scope.g1_boundary: DemoSession, owner isolation, Idempotency-Key, SQLite, and restart recovery start in Day 2 G1

id_format.description: entity prefix followed by a 26-character uppercase Crockford Base32 ULID

endpoints.rule: checks local configuration and data-directory writability; provider network is unchecked and no database check exists in G0

http_error_mapping.422: VALIDATION_ERROR, including FastAPI request validation after conversion to the unified ErrorResponse
http_error_mapping.503: PROVIDER_CONFIG_MISSING or readiness failure before a run is accepted
http_error_mapping.504: PROVIDER_TIMEOUT only when failure occurs before POST /tasks accepts a run
http_error_mapping.502: PROVIDER_ERROR only when failure occurs before POST /tasks accepts a run
http_error_mapping.500: INTERNAL_ERROR for an unexpected REST failure; the public response never includes exception text
http_error_mapping.async_after_202: TOOL_NOT_FOUND, TOOL_INPUT_INVALID, PROVIDER_TIMEOUT, PROVIDER_ERROR, or STREAM_INTERRUPTED use run.failed -> error -> stream.done while the SSE HTTP status remains 200

request_rules.effective_memory_mode: off when memory_mode is off OR current_constraints.memory_disabled is true; otherwise on
request_rules.day1_memory_behavior: effective on still returns an empty retrieval result because G0 has no long-term memory store

sse.persistent_event_id: task-local monotonically increasing integer; SSE id equals data.event_seq
sse.transient_event_id: no SSE id line and data.event_seq is null
sse.cursor_precedence: explicit after_event_seq query wins; otherwise a valid Last-Event-ID header is used; after_offset always comes from query and defaults to 0
sse.manual_reconnect: close EventSource, GET TaskSnapshot, then create a new EventSource with after_event_seq and after_offset
sse.snapshot_merge: a snapshot may replace rendered text only when snapshot.end_offset is greater than or equal to the client's current end_offset
subscription_algorithm: capture persistent and chunk high-water marks and register the subscriber
replay records after both client cursors through the captured high-water marks
drain live events and rely on event_seq/chunk offsets for idempotent duplicate rejection

chunk_buffer.retention: until the run reaches a terminal state; terminal truth remains in TaskSnapshot

sse.terminal_rule: run.completed or run.failed is followed by stream.done; the server closes the stream and the client performs one final GET TaskSnapshot

run_failure.event: valid success-trace prefix ending before terminal events

run_failure.note: possible only when failure follows partial output

metadata_only_rules: persistent event payloads contain identifiers, controlled enums, counts, timings, offsets, and curated safe messages only
partial output is represented by partial_message_id and end_offset, never partial_output
tool arguments contain only language, extraction source, and byte count; tool results use result_ref
fingerprint events contain safe enum summaries and fingerprint_id, never semantic_query or source text
answer text appears only in transient agent.chunk or TaskSnapshot

code_extraction_order: first python or py fenced Markdown block
otherwise the whole trimmed task only when ast.parse succeeds
otherwise skip with NO_EXTRACTABLE_PYTHON; invalid code must be fenced to receive a syntax result in G0

provider.retry: one retry is allowed before the first agent.chunk; no silent retry is allowed after partial output
